title: Questionnaire data — Questionnaire information
description: Identifies each questionnaire response, the participant who gave it, the questionnaire version and the submission date. Holds the table's link keys.

ID.title: Unique identifier for questionnaire response
ID.$comment: Local primary key: unique within this table. The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).

PID.title: Participant identifier
PID.$comment: Many-to-one link to participant.PID. That every PID exists in the participant table cannot be enforced across tables (D044). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).

QUESTIONNAIRE_VERSION.title: Version of questionnaire completed
QUESTIONNAIRE_VERSION.$comment: The dictionary lists no values or format for this string, so none is asserted (D045).

SUBMISSION_DATE.title: Date questionnaire was submitted
SUBMISSION_DATE.$comment: The dictionary type is date but states no delivered string format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).
